title: EWS-Fli1 antisense oligodeoxynucleotide inhibits proliferation of human Ewing's sarcoma and primitive neuroectodermal tumor cells
inspected_locations: Table I and Figure 3 with results, journal page 242
supported_claim: Fusion-junction-directed antisense oligonucleotides have been experimentally tested against EWS-FLI1.
source_interpretation: BPAS1 and BPAS2 targeted the breakpoint and were tested in SK-N-MC cells. ESAS2 targeted the initiation region and was used for most subsequent experiments; it also suppressed normal EWS RNA. The letter cites experimental precedent only, without transferring efficacy or selectivity to EMC.
review: Root and an independent read-only advisor inspected the primary paper. No review article or prior EMC preprint substitutes for this source.
all_other_references: Reused unchanged sources from the accepted September 28 letter, renumbered in order of appearance.
